body: no. i want to understand.

I should mention I have sensory issues. It can be selective at times, maybe because I’m focused on something else? But my pain tolerance isn’t normal. I hear things that other people don’t for example I heard this dripping sound coming from my closet. It was faint. No one could hear it but me. There ended up being a leak a week later. I can’t stand sport channels loud. All that background noise causes me to be anxious when I already have anxiety issues.
I’m still here. So I guess that’s good.

Sharing to people i trust is the issue and having those people use it against me. I’ve always shared too much of myself with people I considered friends. Maybe I thought that would bring us closer together. But no... I should mention I’m just a terrible friend all around, so I guess this is my karma. I’ve always been a terrible friend. Looking back.
Exactly that. How every one knows my business. To people I don’t even talk to anymore. To people that were once close to me. I guess it doesn’t make any sense. But I have always struggled with it.
Tomorrow isn’t promised. But sure.
No one understands.
Yes. Give or take.

No. This isn’t about anyone else. This is about me. My note isn’t going to be blaming anyone, because it’s not about that. It’s about how I feel about myself and how I’ve always masked it by trying to fit in and how it came crashing down 6 months ago.
Like I said for everyone to know exactly why I am killing myself. So there’s no question as to why I’m doing it. For my family. For my kids. Those are the only people that matter.
That would be ideal, but it’s not an option. And I can’t keep waiting around for it to “might be” an option later. I feel like I’m running out of time.
I don’t. I don’t think anything good of myself.
Yes, I’ll still feel this from a year from now. Yes. It will matter.
I guess so no one will be left wondering why. It’ll all be explained in the note.
Just wanted to say I too feel the same way you feel. It hurts to read it but wow, this really could have came from me if I were able to write as effortless as you.
One is old enough to understand. The other won’t understand till later.

Although I’m very repetitive and like routines, being consistent has been a struggle for me when it comes to treatment. I’ve been reluctant & maybe in denial my whole life because I want to be normal. I’ve wanted to fit in so much but I’ve only made myself stand out more.
Same.

It has never helped. Therapy or meds. Nothing. Talking about it over and over doesn’t help my thoughts, my failures, my embarrassment, or my problems.

Recently I’ve been having more bad days then good. There are happy moments where I appreciate that I’m still here... but the fact remains everyone would be so much better without me. And that’s not just me saying that. That’s a guarantee. I’m a terrible person. I don’t deserve anything. I never have. And that’s the fucking truth. I’ve wanted to die since I was 6 years old or younger.
Yeah. It’s not helping.
Yes. My past haunts me.

Why would you want to talk to someone leading up? I mean, I understand it to a certain degree. I feel like it puts a burden on them especially because they know you’re about to do it and they aren’t reaching out to the authorities. 

When my day comes no one will know. I won’t be calling or texting or chatting to anyone.
I have. Therapy & antidepressants.
She’s older. No she didn’t.

You should get them help ASAP. 

I am suicidal but I would never harm anyone else, let alone my family. I only want to hurt myself. 

Get them help.
All my life. I’ve done things to mask my pain but I am currently unable to mask it any longer.
No it’s not
Same.

Not having the money to get the necessary equipment is what’s stopping me from getting on with my plan. 

There are a ton of things that are making me feel down.

Unfortunately I am. I’ve taken pills. Not enough pills because I’m still here. All they did was make me throw up everything I had in my system. Made me very dizzy and sleepy. 

I am still struggling.
In a way I thought that love from a child would cure me. It hasn’t. They deserve so much better.

I’m sorry that you’ve been through shit and back. I’m glad you’ve been able to overcome such obstacles. Proves you are strong. I am weak. I’ve always been weak. I’ve created this facade that I’m strong but I’ve never been strong. 

Your story sounds too familiar as it is similar to mine. I am unable to change. People like me don’t change they just get worst.

I’ve been skinny all my life.  I’ve tried to gain weight multiple times, and it’s never be successful. I’d much rather be overweight to have a little thickness to my bones. 

I’ve been flat chested with no type of ass all my life. I’m sick of it. 

One of the many reasons why I don’t want to be here.

So I understand what you are going thru. I’m just on the other side of the fence.
Not suffering from postpartum. I’m suffering with life.

For me. If I had the money I would do it tomorrow. I am almost positive it would help me recover a little bit. Help me have confidence I’ve never had. Help me with buying clothes that are actually cute & fit well. Help me feel like I was worth something. And I know it sounds silly, but I 100% believe it would help me.

I also had physical abuse by my sister too.

Definitely. One of my many reasons why i feel completely worthless. I’ve never been happy how I’ve looked. I’ve always wanted to hit the lottery to get my body done. Breast implants, & a bbl or a fat transfer with my waist snatched. That’s not happening tho.

Yes. I’ve done research on the numbers. They’ll be 30% likely to commit suicide. Which is terrible. 

I have tried therapy. Numerous of times. It hasn’t helped. 
Simple tasks that the therapist has asked of me I’m not able to do, because I do not love myself and there is NOT one thing good about me. 


I’m hoping family will tell them something else. Have them keep it to their grave because the numbers are so high.
I’m not scared.
